outcome: Third or fourth degree perineal tear
Transfer to higher level of neonatal care
cohort: Singleton hospital deliveries occurring between 2011 and 2012, and 2014-2015 at Kätilöopisto Maternity Hospital in Helsinki (study hospital) and all three delivery units in the Helsinki region (population-based analysis)
finding: Increasing the volume of a delivery unit does not compromise maternal or neonatal outcome.
